"""Steps 7-8: Bayesian player model, Clutch Index, rank ranges. Scheme A = evidence-weighted (recommended); scheme B = the earlier 50/25/25 plan.
Usage: python -I s06_ratings.py <out_dir>"""
import sys, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from clib import fit
OUT = sys.argv[1]; rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
EXC = set(int(x) for x in open(f"{OUT}/exclude_ids.txt").read().split()) if os.path.exists(f"{OUT}/exclude_ids.txt") else set()  # players kept in the model fit but left out of the ranking pool
v = pd.read_parquet(f"{OUT}/value.parquet"); v["x"] = v.pi / 100
XH = 0.85; MINPOP = 60; ND = 1000

def role(side):
    bat = side == "bat"; pc, nc = ("striker_id", "striker_name") if bat else ("bowler_id", "bowler_name")
    d = (v[v.bat_ball] if bat else v).reset_index(drop=True)
    d["yr"], d["yw"], d["ys"] = (d.rae, d.wpaa_bat, d.sq_bat) if bat else (d.rsae, d.wpaa_bowl, d.sq_bowl)
    pid = d[pc].values; xbar = np.average(d.x, weights=d.wt); xc = (d.x - xbar).values
    R = fit(pid, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(d)), xc]), d.yr.values, d.wt.values)
    h = d[d.omega > 0]; hw = (h.wt * h.omega).values; oh = np.ones((len(h), 1))
    W = fit(h[pc].values, oh, h.yw.values, hw); Q = fit(h[pc].values, oh, h.ys.values, hw)
    st = pd.DataFrame({"name": d.groupby(pc)[nc].agg(lambda s: s.mode().iat[0]), "balls_all": d.groupby(pc).size(), "matches_all": d.groupby(pc).match_id.nunique()})
    t = d[d.pi >= 70]; g = t.groupby(pc); lg = t[t.legal].groupby(pc)
    st["p_balls"] = (g.size() if bat else lg.size()); st["p_matches"] = g.match_id.nunique(); st["x_balls"] = (d[d.pi >= 90].groupby(pc).size())
    c_all = d[d.pi < 70].groupby(pc)
    if bat:
        st["p_runs"] = g.bat_runs.sum(); st["p_outs"] = g.striker_out.sum(); st["p_xouts"] = g.x_out.sum(); st["p_sr"] = 100 * st.p_runs / st.p_balls; st["p_xsr"] = 100 * g.x_runs.sum() / st.p_balls
        st["calm_sr"] = 100 * c_all.bat_runs.sum() / c_all.size(); st["p_bdry_pct"] = 100 * g.bat_runs.apply(lambda s: (s >= 4).mean()); st["p_dot_pct"] = 100 * g.bat_runs.apply(lambda s: (s == 0).mean())
    else:
        st["p_runs"] = g.conceded.sum(); st["p_wkts"] = g.bowler_wkt.sum(); st["p_xwkts"] = g.x_wkt.sum(); st["p_econ"] = 6 * st.p_runs / st.p_balls; st["p_xecon"] = 6 * g.x_conc.sum() / st.p_balls
        st["calm_econ"] = 6 * c_all.conceded.sum() / d[(d.pi < 70) & d.legal].groupby(pc).size(); st["p_dot_pct"] = 100 * lg.apply(lambda s: (s.conceded == 0).mean()); st["p_extras_per100"] = 100 * g.apply(lambda s: (~s.legal).mean())
    st["p_val100_raw"] = 100 * g.yr.mean(); st["calm_val100_raw"] = 100 * c_all.yr.mean(); st["raw_lift100"] = st.p_val100_raw - st.calm_val100_raw; st["raw_lift_se"] = 100 * np.sqrt(g.yr.var() / g.size() + c_all.yr.var() / c_all.size()); st["p_wins_total"] = h.assign(y=h.yw * h.omega).groupby(pc).y.sum() / 100
    st = st.fillna({"p_balls": 0, "p_matches": 0}); elig = st[(st.p_balls >= 150) & (st.p_matches >= 15)].index.values; elig = np.array([p for p in elig if p not in EXC])
    pm = d.assign(val=d.yr * d.omega).groupby([pc, "match_id"]).agg(val=("val", "sum"), om=("omega", "sum")).reset_index(); pm = pm[pm.om >= 2]; cg = pm.groupby(pc)
    st["c_matches"] = cg.size(); st["c_pos_share"] = cg.val.apply(lambda s: (s > 0).mean()); st["c_sharpe"] = cg.val.mean() / cg.val.std()
    ix = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(R["ids"])}; iw = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(W["ids"])}; er = np.array([ix[p] for p in elig]); ew = np.array([iw[p] for p in elig])
    z = lambda a: (a - a.mean()) / a.std()
    cz = z(st.c_sharpe.reindex(elig).fillna(0).values)
    def scores(mr, mw, mq):
        est = 100 * (mr[:, 0] + mr[:, 1] * (XH - xbar)); lift = 100 * mr[:, 1] * 0.5
        a = 0.7 * z(est) + 0.3 * z(mw)                                                          # scheme A: chosen by out-of-sample prediction
        dz = z(0.50 * z(est) + 0.35 * z(mw) + 0.15 * z(mq)); lz = z(lift); lz = np.where(dz < 0, np.minimum(lz, 0), lz)
        return est, lift, a, 0.50 * dz + 0.25 * lz + 0.25 * cz                                  # scheme B: earlier plan
    est, lift, sa, sb = scores(R["m"][er], W["m"][ew, 0], Q["m"][ew, 0])
    out = st.reindex(elig).copy(); out["skill100"] = 100 * R["m"][er, 0]; out["est100"] = est; out["wins100"] = W["m"][ew, 0]; out["squeeze"] = Q["m"][ew, 0]
    out["lift100"] = lift; out["lift_sd100"] = 100 * 0.5 * np.sqrt(R["S"][er, 1, 1]); out["lift_lo"] = out.lift100 - 1.645 * out.lift_sd100; out["lift_hi"] = out.lift100 + 1.645 * out.lift_sd100
    var_est = R["S"][er, 0, 0] + 2 * (XH - xbar) * R["S"][er, 0, 1] + (XH - xbar) ** 2 * R["S"][er, 1, 1]; out["est_sd100"] = 100 * np.sqrt(var_est)
    pop_est = 100 * (R["mu"][0] + R["mu"][1] * (XH - xbar)); out["p_above_avg"] = 1 - 0.5 * (1 + np.vectorize(__import__("math").erf)((pop_est - est) / (out.est_sd100.values * np.sqrt(2))))
    out["score_a"] = sa; out["score_b"] = sb; out["clutch"] = 100 * pd.Series(sa, index=elig).rank(pct=True).values
    out["rank"] = pd.Series(-sa, index=elig).rank().astype(int).values; out["rank_b"] = pd.Series(-sb, index=elig).rank().astype(int).values
    Lr = np.linalg.cholesky(R["S"][er] + 1e-12 * np.eye(2)); sw = np.sqrt(W["S"][ew, 0, 0]); sq_ = np.sqrt(Q["S"][ew, 0, 0]); ranks = np.zeros((ND, len(elig)), int)
    for k in range(ND):
        mr = R["m"][er] + np.einsum("ipq,iq->ip", Lr, rng.standard_normal((len(elig), 2)))
        ranks[k] = (-scores(mr, W["m"][ew, 0] + sw * rng.standard_normal(len(elig)), Q["m"][ew, 0])[2]).argsort().argsort() + 1
    out["p_top10"] = (ranks <= 10).mean(0); out["rank_lo"] = np.percentile(ranks, 5, 0); out["rank_hi"] = np.percentile(ranks, 95, 0)
    diag = dict(eligible=len(elig), spread_of_skill_per100=round(100 * float(np.sqrt(R["Sig"][0, 0])), 1), spread_of_pressure_effect_per100=round(100 * 0.5 * float(np.sqrt(R["Sig"][1, 1])), 1),
                typical_uncertainty_of_a_player_lift=round(float(out.lift_sd100.mean()), 1), skill_lift_correlation=round(float(R["Sig"][0, 1] / np.sqrt(R["Sig"][0, 0] * R["Sig"][1, 1])), 2),
                players_with_credible_positive_lift=int((out.lift_lo > 0).sum()), credible_negative_lift=int((out.lift_hi < 0).sum()), raw_lift_beyond_2se=int((out.raw_lift100.abs() > 2 * out.raw_lift_se).sum()), em_iters=R['iters'],
                mean_lift=round(float(100 * 0.5 * R["mu"][1]), 2), top10_overlap_A_vs_B=int(len(set(out[out["rank"] <= 10].index) & set(out[out.rank_b <= 10].index))))
    out = out.sort_values("rank"); out.index.name = "player_id"; out.to_csv(f"{OUT}/ratings_{side}.csv")
    return out, diag

pd.set_option("display.width", 250); pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 40)
for side in ("bat", "bowl"):
    out, diag = role(side); print(f"\n===== {side.upper()} ===== {diag}")
    cols = ["rank", "rank_b", "name", "p_balls", "p_matches"] + (["p_sr", "p_xsr", "calm_sr"] if side == "bat" else ["p_econ", "p_xecon", "calm_econ", "p_wkts", "p_xwkts"]) + \
           ["est100", "est_sd100", "wins100", "p_wins_total", "lift100", "lift_lo", "lift_hi", "c_pos_share", "clutch", "p_top10", "rank_lo", "rank_hi"]
    print(out[cols].head(16).round(2).to_string(index=False))
    print("scheme B (earlier plan) top 10:", ", ".join(out.sort_values("rank_b").name.head(10)))
